note: Client roster for the TMT practice. The pipeline matches new instruments/judgments to clients deterministically, requiring a subject-keyword hit so a client sees only what actually concerns it (not every item from a regulator it follows). Each client carries: 'scope' — the advice scope the partner covers for them, shown on the card and quoted in draft emails; 'gaps' — an honest note where the client's sectoral regulator sits OUTSIDE this tracker's coverage, so silence here is never mistaken for regulatory silence. Keywords are precise multi-word regexes to keep false positives low; tune per client. Replace with the firm's real roster or point at the CRM. No client data leaves the machine.

clients.name: AWS
clients.sector: Global cloud infrastructure and platform services (IaaS/PaaS), India regions and data centres
clients.scope: Cloud and data-centre regulation, data protection and localisation (DPDP), CERT-In cybersecurity obligations, intermediary/safe-harbour status, encryption and government-access, FDI and digital-competition policy.
clients.gaps: RBI/SEBI financial-sector cloud and outsourcing directions, and state-level data-centre incentives/electricity policy, are outside this tracker's coverage.

clients.name: Roblox
clients.sector: Online gaming + user-generated-content platform (large minor user base)
clients.scope: Online-gaming and intermediary regulation, minor-safety and age-verification obligations, dark-pattern and advertising standards, content moderation, and DPDP compliance for the India user base.
clients.gaps: State gazettes are outside coverage — state online-gaming statutes (e.g. Tamil Nadu, Karnataka) will not appear here.

clients.name: Accenture
clients.sector: Global IT / consulting services + India delivery centres (data processor at scale)
clients.scope: IT/ITeS and outsourcing regulation: DPDP processor obligations, CERT-In incident reporting and empanelment, cross-border data transfer, SEZ/STPI and FDI policy, AI and GCC policy for delivery operations.
clients.gaps: RBI bank-outsourcing directions and sectoral financial-services regulation — relevant to Accenture's BFSI clients — are outside coverage, as are Commerce-ministry SEZ/STPI notifications.

clients.name: Annalise.ai
clients.sector: Clinical AI — radiology decision-support software deployed to Indian healthcare providers
clients.scope: AI and health-data regulation for India deployments: DPDP consent and health-data processing, MeitY AI advisories and model-governance obligations, cybersecurity of clinical systems, telemedicine-adjacent rules.
clients.gaps: CDSCO and the Medical Device Rules — the sectoral regulator for software-as-a-medical-device — are outside this tracker's coverage, as are MoHFW/NMC telemedicine rules; instruments from those regulators will not appear here.
